releases.name: Version 1.5.0
releases.body:
* Added developer commentary; Ernesto provides the narration (available only after completing this mod once).
* *Ernesto loves facing each other atop the two pairs of jagged stumps near the waterfall.*
* Added new dialogue for Gabbro, Chert, Esker, Riebeck, and Feldspar.
* Adjusted the rendering order so that HUD markers remain visible even when inside clouds.
* Fixed an issue where the "unidentified signal" notification would disappear upon acquiring Gabbro's signal when starting a new save file.
* Adjusted the content of several ship log entries.
releases.bodyZh:
* 添加了开发者评论；Ernesto(埃列尔托)提供旁白（仅完成此模组一次后可用）。
* *Ernesto(埃列尔托)喜欢面对彼此，位于瀑布附近的两对尖锐树桩顶端。*
* 为加布罗(加布罗)、切特(切特)、埃斯科(埃斯科)、瑞拜克(瑞拜克)和费尔德斯巴(费尔德斯巴)添加了新的对话。
* 调整了渲染顺序，以便HUD标记即使在云层内部也能保持可见。
* 修复了在新保存文件中获取加布罗(加布罗)信号时，“未知信号”通知会消失的问题。
* 调整了几个飞船日志条目的内容。

releases.name: Version 1.4.6
releases.body: * Ship Log map mode no longer reveals the location of a certain entity too early. (Once you understand the location, Ship Log map mode will also display the correct location.)
releases.bodyZh: * 飞船日志地图模式不再过早地揭示某个实体的位置。(一旦你理解了位置，飞船日志地图模式也会显示正确的位置。)

releases.name: Version 1.4.5
releases.body:
* Fix #7 by setting hideProxy as true.
* If a certain object is stuck in a certain laboratory, the door is designed to break to prevent entry.
releases.bodyZh:
* 通过设置 hideProxy 为 true 修复 #7。
* 如果某个物体卡在某个实验室里，门的设计会破裂以阻止进入。

releases.name: Version 1.4.4
releases.body:
* Disable the item if the player heads straight to the cannon without filling in the initial ship log.
* Fixed an issue where the player could get trapped inside a specific building in the final sequence at the specific place (though doing so required a deliberate effort).
* Fixed a missing character of Japanese translation.
releases.bodyZh:
* 如果玩家没有填写初始飞船日志就直奔炮台，则禁用该物品。
* 修复了玩家在最终序列的特定地点被困在特定建筑物内的问题（尽管这需要刻意为之）。
* 修复了日语翻译中缺失的字符。

releases.name: Version 1.4.3
releases.body:
* Fix unidentified signal notification in the final sequence in the specific place.
* Fix the latest building collision in the final sequence in the specific place.
releases.bodyZh:
* 修复最终序列中特定位置的未识别信号提示。
* 修复最终序列中特定位置的最新建筑碰撞。

releases.name: Version 1.4.1
releases.body:
* Update Chinese translation. Thank you, @SanBaiMing !
* Fix audio volume issue in the final sequence in the specific place.
* Fix gravity issue in the final sequence in the specific place.

releases.name: Version 1.4.0
releases.body:
Finally, I have added a specific session to a certain location. (Regarding the accompanying text: I used machine translation for the Chinese version, so I would appreciate it if you could review it when you have the time, @SanBaiMing and @GeBlaster )

To be honest, I think that drawing was enough to convey the essence, but I just really wanted to give this a try as well ;;)

releases.name: Version 1.3.0
releases.body:
This is an update after the conclusion of the jam.
Changes:
* Updated the Chinese translation by @SanBaiMing (however, I have added some machine translations of the Chinese text related to the changes listed below, so I would appreciate it if you could check if it is as @SanBaiMing intended.)
* Increased the spacing between some ship log cards to make the unread mark more clearly visible.
* Added a feature to display the remaining time in a certain location on the computer.
* Fixed an issue where a certain mesh-like model was overhanging the stairs (a cylinder will indent inward when twisted unless the number of vertices is increased).
* Corrected some English text to make it more accurate.

**Also, please do not remove the sand or the anglerfish using another mod; doing so will cause a sequence break.**

releases.name: Version 1.2.0
releases.body:
This is an update after the conclusion of the jam.
Changes:

* Add Chinese translation by @GeBlaster and @SanBaiMing (#2).
* Complete Japanese translation.
* While watching Fenna's video, I noticed that there was an instance where the word "Vessel" was written as "ship," so I corrected it.

**Also, please do not remove the sand or the anglerfish using another mod; doing so will cause a sequence break.**
